name: Minori Seminars
description: Minori Seminars is a quiet, single-column WordPress landing theme designed for executive management desks, training institutes, and public leadership seminars. Built with classical serif headings, structured schedule rows, and high-key documentary photography, it guides managers cleanly from introduction to seat reservation. Features full responsiveness, international language support, and refined scroll-linked presentation inspired by traditional Japanese management institutions.
